name: Fuelventa
what_they_do: Digital infrastructure platform connecting Nigerian filling stations, depots, logistics operators, and inventory sponsors across the downstream energy value chain. Its VentaCore, VentaHub, and Venta Mobile suite manages forecourt shifts, sales, cash handovers, depot haulage, and FuelCycle inventory financing.
